name: Pope Innocent IV
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1243 to 1254
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 25 June 1243 to his death in 1254.

checks.lead: Pope Innocent IV (Latin: Innocentius IV; c. 1195 – 7 December 1254), born Sinibaldo Fieschi, was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 25 June 1243 to his death in 1254.
